content: Hello! Thank you for contacting customer support. How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I’m having trouble accessing my account on your portal. Can you help me reset my password?
Of course! For security reasons, I’ll need to verify your identity first. Could you please provide the email address associated with your account?
Thank you, Jane. I’ve just sent a verification code to your registered email. Please check your inbox and let me know the 6-digit code you received.
Perfect, the code matches! Now, please click the reset link in your email. It will open a secure page where you can set a new password.
I clicked the link. It’s asking for my username and new password.
Please enter your username—typically your email address—and create a strong new password. Make sure it’s at least 8 characters, with a mix of letters and numbers.
All set! I’ve updated my password and can access my account now. Thanks for your help.
